label: FICTION. Eleven invented candidate paths. Six are feasible; five are deliberately written to be refused, so the refusals are demonstrated rather than described.

paths.rationale: The practice exists in one place; the gap is consistency, so the work is making it repeat and be recorded.

steps.capability_change: Apply the branch rule requiring review to the remaining repositories
steps.observable_advancement: Every repository in the group returns a branch-protection export showing the review requirement
steps.effort_basis: ASSUMED: configuration per repository plus a short migration window

steps.capability_change: Record review outcomes so a month of merges can be sampled
steps.observable_advancement: A one-month sample of merges each shows a recorded reviewer distinct from the author
steps.effort_basis: ASSUMED: reporting against existing merge data

paths.rationale: A published standard with no review record is a documented practice, not a practised one. The next level is doing it once and recording it.

steps.capability_change: Run the privileged-access review the standard already requires, and record the result
steps.observable_advancement: A dated review record exists naming the accounts reviewed and the decisions taken

paths.rationale: Same destination with one part-time reviewer: narrow the first review to the highest-privilege accounts rather than attempting the whole estate, so the practice starts rather than stalling.

steps.capability_change: Review only the highest-privilege account tier this cycle, with the scope written down
steps.observable_advancement: A dated review record exists, stating its own scope limit and the tier covered
steps.effort_basis: ASSUMED: a narrower population than SEC-01-A

paths.rationale: Approvals are already consistent and recorded. The remaining level is about whether the control achieves anything measurable, not about doing more of it.

steps.capability_change: Define the outcome the approval control is meant to produce, and how it would be measured
steps.observable_advancement: A written measure definition exists naming the numerator, denominator and observation window

steps.capability_change: Measure the outcome over a stated window and report it with its denominator
steps.observable_advancement: A report states the measured value, the window, the denominator, and the count of changes whose outcome is unknown
steps.effort_basis: ASSUMED: one reporting cycle over existing change records

paths.rationale: One analyst, part time. The route is to make the existing single sign-off repeat on a defined trigger rather than to build a review programme.

steps.capability_change: Define the trigger that requires a reviewer sign-off on an AI-assisted output
steps.observable_advancement: A written trigger exists that a third party could apply to a given output and get the same answer

steps.capability_change: Apply the trigger across a quarter and retain the sign-offs
steps.observable_advancement: A quarter's outputs each carry a sign-off or a recorded reason the trigger did not apply
steps.effort_basis: NOT ESTIMATED: depends on how many outputs the trigger catches, which is not knowable until the trigger is written in AI-01-A.

paths.rationale: Three owners keep three spreadsheets. Rather than asking them to agree a format, take the membership data from the shared identity service they all already use.

steps.capability_change: Review group membership from the shared service's export on a quarterly cycle, replacing the three spreadsheets
steps.observable_advancement: Two consecutive quarters each produce a review record derived from the shared export, covering every group in scope
steps.effort_basis: ASSUMED: two cycles plus the cutover from three spreadsheets
prerequisites: EXTERNAL:the central identity service exposes a membership export

paths.rationale: REFUSAL CASE, written deliberately. Proposes reaching consistent practice by writing more documents.

steps.capability_change: Write a detailed privileged-access review procedure
Write a supporting standard and a RACI matrix
steps.observable_advancement: Both documents are published and approved

paths.rationale: REFUSAL CASE. Proposes going from a policy document to measured outcomes in one plan.

steps.capability_change: Stand up a fully measured privileged-access review programme

paths.rationale: REFUSAL CASE. Plans a route from a practice nobody has assessed.

steps.capability_change: Introduce a review step for assistive code generation

paths.rationale: REFUSAL CASE. The evidence kind is right, but one step's completion is not checkable.

steps.capability_change: Improve the group review process and raise awareness across owners

paths.rationale: REFUSAL CASE. A step depends on work no step in the path delivers, and it is not declared external.

steps.capability_change: Sample a month of merges for recorded reviewers
steps.observable_advancement: A one-month sample shows a recorded reviewer on each merge
